text:
rachel: Heads-up — Venice Health wants Redwood to act as a drop-in replacement for their current vendor (HeliosAPI). Minimal SDK changes, identical sync + async shapes, and they sent a short security checklist due Friday. Can we POC?
omar: Yes. Main items: top-level field mapping (`context` -> `input`), streaming framing (Helios uses chunked JSON lines), webhook callbacks for async jobs, and legacy error-code expectations.
jeff: +1. Also they rely on an idempotency header `X-Helios-Dedupe`. Will need to preserve or synthesize that.
maria: Security: Venice is HIPAA. They want a BAA, KMS details, audit log retention options, and mTLS for management endpoints. I can own the questionnaire.
omar: Customer sample cURL (redacted) posted in doc. Quick plan: 1) lightweight proxy that accepts Helios endpoints and translates to Redwood API; 2) run parity suite on N=50 canonical clinical notes; 3) 30-day pilot with fallback routing if drift > threshold; 4) finalize pricing (pilot credit or short-term blended rate).achel: They asked about keeping current per-request price for 60 days. Sales: we can offer a pilot credit tied to committed usage rather than locking list price. Finance needs to approve.
jeff: Dev notes: streaming -> transform SSE to chunked JSON lines (wrap events in `data: {...}
` frames). Error mapping: map validation -> 422, duplicate -> 409. Also copy `X-Helios-Limit` headers (synthesize if needed).
sec-team: (automated) Reminder: Hosted infra does not accept customer-supplied long-lived tokens. Use an auth-proxy that validates Helios tokens and mints ephemeral Redwood tokens for the pilot. Dedicated can support mTLS/customer-managed keys.
maria: I'll prepare questionnaire answers and the BAA options. Need an integration owner to fill KMS/HSM details (who can own that?).
omar: I can prototype the shim. ETA 2 business days if I get example cURLs and webhook signing secret. I'll post a staging endpoint and test cURL.
deploy-bot: deploy started by omar for branch shim/venice-compat at commit aa11bb - staging proxy: https://staging-proxy.redwood.net/helios/v2/complete
omar: Staging up. Basic sync flow works, streaming wrapper needs final EOF frame fix.
rachel: Thanks team — I'll send the POC plan to Venice and request the canonical prompt set + metric thresholds. Will follow up after parity run. :thumbsup:
